summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of PF Resolve prototype. 8/8 pytest backend tests passing (account seed, transfer status, 4x AI endpoints, submit-not-ready 400, fix->submit->reset flow with persistence check). Frontend journey walked end-to-end at 1440x900: Landing -> Overview -> Diagnostic -> Resolution -> generated request + copy -> 'Ive fixed it' -> Ready -> Review -> Submit (reference PF-DEMO-48291 shown) -> Tracking (Processing). Assistant panel opens, accepts input and returns an answer. Reset demo button restores REJECTED state. Backend state reset at end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores demo state in MongoDB keyed by fixed _id and mutates it globally; fine for single-user hackathon prototype but means concurrent testers/users share state. Consider noting this limitation.

workflow.apply_submit sets status to PROCESSING but there is never a SUBMITTED intermediate state persisted; the timeline post-submit reads correctly but internal 'SUBMITTED' branch in build_timeline is effectively unreachable via API.

AI assistant answer observed once referring to 'PROCESSING status ... no rejection reason shown' which is grounded in current state (correct), but after a reset the assistant panel still shows the previous answer - acceptable for prototype.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds Rahul Sharma demo state on first request via mock_data.initial_state(); tests call POST /api/demo/reset before/after.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Single shared demo state doc in MongoDB (_id=rahul-sharma-demo). Always POST /api/demo/reset before and after mutating flows. All data-testid selectors listed in review request are present and working. AI endpoints respond within ~5s and return either 'ai' or 'fallback' source - both accepted.
